## "date_asset_taken"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
Timestamp of the type: ISO 8601:YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ or null.

**Description of metadata field:**  
The date and time of when the original media were created (e.g., when the original raw image was taken). This should also be available from the exif data of each image.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Ingestion server when metadata is first created.

**Updated where and when:**  
Never.

**Generated by:**  
Ingestion server.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
date_asset_taken

**Maps to in Specify:**  
Date media created (fileCreatedDate) in attachment record

**Notes and issues:**  
None.
